mapper.select: select distinct category_title from watcha_rank where save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank)

select m.period, m.country, w.*, r.media_rank from media m, watcha w, watcha_rank r where r.category_title = #{categoryTitle} and r.media_id = w.media_id and m.media_id = w.media_id and r.save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank) order by r.media_rank

select w.img_src, r.* from watcha w left join watcha_rank r on r.media_id = w.media_id and r.save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank) where w.media_id = #{media_id} order by r.media_rank asc limit 1
select m.*, w.img_src from media m, watcha w where genre like concat('%', #{genre}, '%') and m.media_id = w.media_id and m.media_div = #{mediaDiv}
select *, count(*) as total from media_comment where media_id = #{media_id}
mapper.insert: insert into media_comment ( media_id, writer, content, assess_rate, save_date ) values ( #{media_id}, #{writer}, #{content}, #{assessRate}, date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') )
